title: Shared task state
description: $(git rev-parse --git-common-dir)/tasks/state/<ID>.json — the changing part of a task's status, shared by every worktree and never committed. Written by the launcher or the CLI, never by the agent. See the taskmoor task format, spec/README.md (format = 1).

lifecycle.description: Only the two lifecycle values git and the task file cannot answer.

worktree.description: Absolute path of the task's worktree.

base.description: The main-branch commit the task's branch started from.

writer.description: The program that wrote this version, with its version.

harness.description: Absent until a harness is launched for the task.

status.description: The OSC 7501 root record's state, or what the terminal knows without one.

kind.description: Why the program is blocked, only when it reported a reason.

session.description: The harness's own id of the running session, when the launcher knows it; readers match the running program by it before falling back to the worktree.
